Trump Announces Greenland Oil and Gas Exploration Plans

U.S. President Donald Trump announced that "massive" oil, gas, and mineral exploration is set to begin in Greenland. This announcement follows a security deal signed a month prior with Greenland and Denmark to bolster American military presence on the island. However, Greenland has contradicted Trump's claim, stating that "massive" oil and gas drilling is not about to commence. Trump also hailed a deal for Taiwan to buy 30% of Alaskan gas for 20 years as "one of the biggest deals ever."
